Heavy angular wood silhouettes and visibly readable cut ends. A low, broken irregular outline of a few rounded tan-grey fieldstones around the bottom, never a thick masonry bowl. Pile should be impressive and tall enough to feel like a community bonfire, width about 740 pixels, height about 500 pixels in a square 1024 canvas. Viewed elevated from the front, same perspective as game screenshot, see log tops and ground ellipse. Base contact at x512 y935, subject horizontally centred; leave entire upper third transparent for separate animated flames. Soft small contact shadow. No fire, no glow, no smoke, no ground clearing, no greenery, no roof, no cooking pot, no metal cauldron. True transparent background. Rich clean hand-painted game illustration, rounded bold shapes, warm brown contours, restrained readable textures, soft painted highlights, never photographic or tiny noisy microdetail. No text/UI/characters.

prompts.bonfireFlames: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: animation sprite sheet ONLY FLAMES on true transparent background. Produce EIGHT consecutive distinct frames of one substantial BONFIRE FLAME in an exact four-column by two-row grid, wide landscape sheet, equal square cells. No cell lines or labels. Each frame same baseline and centre, same overall scale, no clipping, generous transparent padding. Each is a big cluster of 4–6 overlapping broad curling tongues, dark warm burnt-orange outer contours, rich orange/red outer bodies, golden yellow inner shapes, restrained cream highlights. Flame base wide and low enough to surround a stack of logs, height 1.15 times its width. ALL frames only flame, NO logs, NO stones, NO ground, NO container, NO black backing or glow rectangle. Saturated warm luminous palette, no blue, no lens effects, no semitransparent photorealistic gas, no huge amorphous plume. Crisp cartoon painterly shapes that match the character and map, not a generic fire icon.
